description: This file defines an AssistantTextParser utility for parsing and segmenting assistant responses with special tags such as <think> and <final> to distinguish between different types of content like thinking and response segments.

classes.name: AssistantTextSegment
classes.description: A data structure representing a segment of assistant text with an associated type (thinking or response).

methods.name: segments(from:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Parses raw text into segments, optionally including 'thinking' segments based on HTML-like tags.

methods.name: visibleSegments(from:)
methods.description: Returns only response segments, excluding 'thinking' segments.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:includeThinking:)
methods.description: Determines if the raw text contains visible (response) content, optionally including 'thinking'.

methods.name: hasVisibleContent(in:)
methods.description: Convenience method to determine if raw text has visible response content, excluding 'thinking'.
